training_objective: 0.4*(1-PAS cosine)+0.4*(1-PDP cosine)+0.2*complex MSE on FIT RMS normalized H
selection: highest official composite score on fixed16 inner validation positions; full inner validation diagnostic only
refit: fresh initialization on outerFIT, selected_updates*n_refit/n_screen; no outer truth

frequency_model: 192 parallel signed complex signal heads, geometry shared within band
cosine_training_numerics: float64 products and sums; zero denominator replaced before sqrt; zero rows retained
